text:
maria: Quick sync — SOC2 keystore/KMS integration. Audit kickoff in two weeks. Need a concise owners + blocker list so I can pass to auditors. Specifically: (A) who owns rotation/history evidence, (B) HSM attestation status, (C) staging->prod cert/deploy blockers. Ping owners, short status please.

 tim: I can take (A) — will pull rotation history + sample access logs and produce a zip for auditors. Question: preferred format? auditors mentioned CSV + JSONL in previous engagement. I'll do both. Assign ENGSEC-780 to me.

 olivia: I'll own (B) HSM attestation + KMS rotation runbook. Quick FYI: staging is failing TLS during handshake, likely cert CN mismatch; tagging @eng-infra. Log snippet: ```2026-03-16T10:12:04Z WARN tls: x509: certificate is valid for keystore.internal, not keystore-staging.internal```

 kevin: I opened a docs PR with the rotation template and evidence checklist: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/87 — needs 2nd review. Marked it eng-sre for review. @tim can you skim the evidence checklist?

 tim: will review PR #87 by EOD today. For the audit zip I'll include: rotation-history.csv (cols: key_id, rotated_at, prev_key_id, user), audit_events_sample.jsonl (last 30 days filtered by keystore service), and a README.md describing queries used. Is that OK?

 maria: auditors requested: rotation timeline CSV + last 30 days of per-key access logs + provider attestation letter for HSM. Also they want a short explanation of the retention policy and where logs are stored (S3 path). I'll put that into ENGSEC-780 checklist.

 deploy-bot: [automated] deploy scheduled: keystore-staging canary -> 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z. CI: infra#442, docs#87.

 olivia: dependency: eng-infra needs to update staging certs before canary. @eng-infra please confirm ETA on infra#442 (cert fix).

 sara: eng-infra here — infra#442 is ready, currently in CI. We have a small cert rotation step that needs a DB migration window; planning window tomorrow 04:00-05:00 UTC. If that works we can flip staging certs then.

 maria: perfect — that aligns. Action items: tim -> zip of evidence + queries (due Wed EOD), olivia -> HSM attestation draft + runbook (due Wed), kevin -> follow up on docs PR approvals, sara/eng-infra -> cert flip in the scheduled window. I'll bundle into ENGSEC-780 and update auditors.

 audit-bot: [automated] evidence request created: ENGSEC-780-REQ-01. Please attach rotation-history.csv and audit_events_sample.jsonl to ticket.

 kevin: quick ask — who can +1 the docs PR after tim? @olivia can you review the attestation wording in docs once it's up?

 olivia: will review docs wording after I push attestation draft later today.

 maria: thanks all. If anything blocks the cert flip or evidence delivery, ping this thread asap. Trying to keep the audit checkpoint clean and avoid last-minute rush. :thumbsup:
